references.title: FFXIV UI overview
references.observation: Minimap shows nearby locations and enemy/ally markers. Opening it leads to a map. Inventory supports sorting and equipment actions; region/world maps and zoom are described.
references.ourProposal: An original ridge map, synthetic player and shape-coded contacts; staged bag comparison and return to camp.
references.limits: Our coordinates, arrow geometry, icon shapes, equipment values and controls are not FFXIV measurements or an emulation of its complete UI.

references.title: Making a Mini Map with the Map Controller Device
references.observation: Describes shape, player-viewpoint rotation, zoom and full-frame framing. Device priority chooses which map controller wins.
references.ourProposal: Circle/square, north/heading, continuous local zoom, and area framing are adjustable in one scene.
references.limits: Our zoom0.7..2.8 and world-unit scale are synthetic. Controller priority, indoor transitions and 3D map captures are not implemented. Marker draw order is not called controller priority.

references.title: Map Indicator Devices
references.observation: Documents map visibility, icon scale, team/class filtering and objective pulses.
references.ourProposal: Marker size, category visibility, minimap/area-map objective scope, and pulse can be seen immediately.
references.limits: No team/class permissions or event-bound device logic is simulated. Reduced motion suppresses our CSS pulse.

references.title: Preseason Item Shop Update
references.observation: Describes recommended/all-item views, contextual reasons and common-supply quick-buy sidebars.
references.ourProposal: A fixed route-recommendation flag and common-supply shortcuts lead through the same transaction review flow.
references.limits: Recommendations are authored fixture data. No real player data, opponent analysis or current League build is claimed. Our quantity, coins, confirmation and receipt are original transaction examples.

references.title: Season 1 Outcomes Report
references.verification: Official URL supplied by parent; initial web fetch returned article, later detail fetches timed out; official search result corroborated outer-fringe behavior. No screenshot inspection.
references.observation: Distinguishes directional contacts at the motion-tracker fringe from more precise in-range information, in a historical change discussion.
references.ourProposal: The rim arrows identify direction; inner markers identify a projected position.
references.limits: Our arrows are not Halo radar art or mechanics. Do not describe this as a universal radar convention or current shipping-build test.
